column1: # selftest-sweep-baseline.tsv — the committed bound on the UN-DEFERRED serial sum (#629).
# WHAT THIS IS. tools/selftest-slow-suites.tsv defers every suite at or above its declared
# threshold so lean-gate.sh milestone 3's local sweep stays inside the harness's ~120s reap. This
# file is the other half: the total cost of everything that table did NOT defer, plus the drift
# allowed over it. tools/check-sweep-bound.sh reads both.
# WHY A DRIFT ALLOWANCE AND NOT A FIXED CEILING (D-3). The quantity that matters is GROWTH — a
# suite that arrived or grew while staying untabled. A fixed constant would either be the reap
# bound (which this sum is only a proxy for; the local sweep runs in parallel, so its wall time is
# far under the serial total) or an arbitrary number nobody could re-derive.
# RE-BASELINING IS AN EXPLICIT REVIEWED COMMIT, never an automatic rewrite. Edit the two numbers
# below and say in the commit what was measured, when, and on which lane. A re-baseline that
# absorbs a grown suite without saying so is how a bound rots into decoration.
# WHICH LANE THIS WAS MEASURED ON MATTERS (D-12). The enforcing surface is
# .github/workflows/nightly-guards.yml's ubuntu wholesale lane, so the seed is taken there — a
# baseline describes the lane that checks it. For contrast, the same 59 suites measured 119s on an
# arm64 macOS workstation against 112s on the runner: 6% apart, because roughly two thirds of the
# set is pinned at the one-second floor and the variance lives in a short tail. That spread is
# what the allowance below is set against.
# THE EMITTER IS PART OF THE UNIT. run-selftests.sh charges a sub-second suite one whole second,
# so this total is not the wall clock of a serial sweep and is not meant to be. Baseline and
# checked sum come through the same emitter, which is what makes the comparison mean anything.
# key<TAB>value
baseline-seconds
allowance-percent
# Provenance, for the reader who has to decide whether a red is real:
#   measured-on      2026-08-21
#   measured-lane    nightly-guards.yml / wholesale-selftests (ubuntu-latest), --full
#   measured-tree    the #629 branch at implementation time
#   undeferred-count 60 of 73 discovered suites
